images.name: phasic
images.alt: Two dopamine charts: a flat, wiggly tonic line with a wedge of cheese, and a sharp phasic spike with a Norwegian flag. Cartoon Gravel God drinks beside them.

images.name: never-coming-out-1
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God stands in the dark mouth of a rock tunnel with a beer and cheese at his feet, saying: "I'm never coming out."

images.name: say-no-to-drugs
images.joke: Say NO to Drugs / It all makes so much sense now!
images.note: Thinking face without the hand on his chin.
images.alt: A heart of colourful pills on a wooden table next to a "Say NO to Drugs" note; cartoon Gravel God, thinking, says: "It all makes so much sense now!"

images.name: feels-great
images.joke: This feels great, I want to be here, I love this. (lolz)
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God rides away from us down a dusty gravel road through dry hills, saying: "This feels great, I want to be here, I love this. (lolz)"

images.name: dopamine-layering
images.joke: How can I train without coffee, snacks, my phone, music, and a beer at the end?
images.alt: In a dark gym, cartoon Gravel God shrugs over a coffee, a croissant, a phone, a speaker and a beer: "How can I train without coffee, snacks, my phone, music, and a beer at the end?"

images.name: hangover-future-me
images.joke: Hangover? Sounds like a problem for future me.
images.alt: A crowd dances under falling confetti; cartoon Gravel God grins, hands on hips: "Hangover? Sounds like a problem for future me."

images.name: cold-shower
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God grimaces under a running shower in a sepia bathroom, saying: "I hate that this works."

images.name: dope
images.alt: A chalkboard with "Dopamine", its formula C8H11NO2 and its molecule drawing; cartoon Gravel God stands grinning beside it.
